title: Coastal Marine Charters
specs: Fast access to Gulf Stream only 3–5 miles offshore for top sport-fishing waters
Over 200 species of saltwater fish including sailfish, mahi-mahi, kingfish, snapper, wahoo, grouper
Sightseeing tours offer views of Palm Beach Island, Peanut Island, Jupiter Island, and marine wildlife like dolphins and manatees
Snorkeling trips to top local destinations including Peanut Island, Blue Heron Bridge, Coral Gardens, Breakers Reef, Munyon Island, John D. MacArthur Beach State Park, and Singer Island reefs
All skill levels welcome, including beginners and families
No experience needed for fishing or snorkeling trips
US Coast Guard licensed captains and safety briefing provided
Private charters available for birthdays, bachelor parties, corporate outings, and special occasions
Small-group and private fishing charters, not party boats
Private sightseeing charters for small groups with customizable itineraries
